findings.title: Public findMany method removed without updating callers
findings.body: The diff deletes InsightsBookingService.findMany (which executed bookingTimeStatusDenormalized.findMany with auth+filter AND) and replaces it with getBaseConditions returning Prisma.Sql. Only two files are changed, so any existing caller still importing/calling findMany will fail to compile or throw at runtime. Removing a public service method is a breaking API change and requires migrating all call sites to $queryRaw with the new conditions.

findings.title: OR fragments built without outer parentheses cause precedence bugs
findings.body: buildFilterConditions builds `("eventTypeId" = X) OR ("eventParentId" = X)` with no surrounding parens, and buildOrgAuthorizationCondition/buildTeamAuthorizationCondition build `(${acc}) OR (${condition})` with no outer parens. getBaseConditions only wraps when both auth and filter exist. If a caller uses the fragment directly as `WHERE ${auth} AND <extra>` or `WHERE ${filter} AND <extra>`, SQL AND binds tighter than OR, so e.g. `a AND b OR c AND d AND e` evaluates as `(a AND b) OR ((c AND d) AND e)` instead of the intended `((a AND b) OR (c AND d)) AND e`, leaking or hiding rows. Fragments containing OR must be parenthesized at construction.
